notablePrerequisites: Gilded Lotus does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Lifecraft Awakening by paying {1}{G}, putting a +1/+1 counter on Gilded Lotus and causing it to become a 0/0 Construct artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying {2}{U}, attaching it to Gilded Lotus.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 4.
